scenarios.title: 车主首页（车辆列表 + 最新档案）
商家列表（项目报价分页）

boundaries: synthetic owners/vehicles/archives and one synthetic project; no production data
core HTTP endpoints only; no AI, WeChat, SMS or real payment provider in the timed path
single host with MySQL and backend containers; not a production capacity proof
no soak, spike decay or fault injection; no cold-start or real-network measurement
order creation is spread over synthetic shops; one shop still serialises on its row lock

environment.client_position: owned Linux container on direct Docker network, separate from backend, same host

method.measurement: perf_counter around one round trip per sample; per-round barrier release
method.order_distribution: 500 concurrent orders spread over 300 synthetic shops
